description: Read a file from one of your Prized boxes, up to 1 MiB. Text comes back 60,000 characters at a time (a longer file's answer gives the offset to read on from); PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP images come back as images; other binary files need encoding "base64". Paths are relative to your home on the box, ~/..., or absolute. It does not wake a paused box: resume_box first, or use run_on_box (cat, head, tail).

box.description: The box: its name (such as mango) or its id, from list_boxes.

encoding.description: Leave out for text (or an image); "base64" for the raw bytes of a binary file.

offset.description: For text: the character to read from, as the previous answer gave it. Default 0.

path.description: The file, such as app/out.json (under your home on the box) or /var/log/syslog.

name: read_box_file
title: Read a file from a box
